relationship_to_exploratory_run: Separate, additional run. Does not overwrite or replace qa-audit/live-openai-flask-validation/ (frozen at commit 0ce14da). Resolves that run's sampling-protocol deviation (lost first A/B response bodies) via a redesigned capture mechanism (see first_response_capture_mechanism below).

first_response_capture_mechanism.design: A page.on('response') listener is registered BEFORE the Architectural Explanation button is clicked, so the chronologically-first-to-complete matching network response is captured unambiguously regardless of React StrictMode's duplicate dispatch. That response is written to raw/target-<x>-first-response.json IMMEDIATELY via a synchronous writeFileSync, followed by an explicit read-back-and-verify step, before any screenshot, evidence-panel interaction, or navigation to the next target occurs. Had persistence failed, the script was designed to throw a fatal error and halt the entire run rather than regenerate -- this path was never exercised because persistence succeeded for all three targets.
first_response_capture_mechanism.outcome: All three targets' genuine first responses were durably persisted before any further step. Unlike the exploratory run, this run completed with zero crash.

targets.label: A
targets.preselected_claim_note: R2-TDC-1 asserts Flask.run calls cli.load_dotenv (app.py:710). The model instead proposed 'run calls get_load_dotenv' (app.py:709) -- a real, different, adjacent function (a boolean condition-check helper in helpers.py, distinct from the action function cli.load_dotenv it gates) -- and did not propose the exact preselected proposition. targets.label: B
targets.preselected_claim_note: First claim in the persisted first response is an EXACT match to R2-TDI-3 (blueprints.Blueprint inherits sansio.blueprints.Blueprint, evidence blueprints.py:18) and is SUPPORTED.

ui_render_discrepancy.description: The browser's rendered Architectural Explanation panel for target B (and therefore screenshots 07-10-target-b-*.png and 15-insufficient-evidence.png) display a DIFFERENT, later real generation than the persisted first-response.json: 3 claims (2 supported + 1 insufficient_evidence: 'Blueprint reaches Scaffold through a call path') instead of the persisted 2 claims (both supported, 0 insufficient). This is NOT a repeat of the exploratory run's data-loss defect -- the genuine first response WAS captured and durably persisted before this was ever discovered, exactly as designed. It is a newly observed, distinct phenomenon: React's StrictMode mount/unmount/remount cycle assigns an internal 'cancelled' flag per effect instance that is NOT correlated with network response arrival order -- the request from the effect instance that survives to render wins, regardless of whether its response happened to arrive at the browser before or after the other duplicate's. Network-arrival order (what this script captures and persists) and React-render order (what screenshots depict) can therefore diverge. Confirmed NOT to have occurred for targets A or C (their screenshots exactly match their persisted first responses).
ui_render_discrepancy.root_cause: React StrictMode (src/main.tsx) double-invoking useArchitecturalExplanation's effect; the two resulting real, independent OpenAI calls returned genuinely different LLM samples (non-deterministic proposal step), and this is the first observed case in this initiative where the rendered (React-surviving) response differs in CONTENT from the network-arrival-first response.
ui_render_discrepancy.consequence_for_this_audit: The structured audit below (schema/bounded-reference/vocabulary/verifier/correctness) for target B uses ONLY the persisted raw/target-b-first-response.json (2 claims), per the predeclared 'first successfully returned explanation' protocol. Screenshots 07 (pre-generation) and 11 remain valid; 08/09/10/15 depict the second (non-sample) generation and must not be read as depicting the persisted sample's content. Source-navigation correctness for target B's persisted sample is established via independent read-only GET /api/source-regions/{id} re-fetches (see source_navigation below), not via the mismatched screenshots.

verdict_rationale: All CONFIRMATORY PASS criteria are met on the basis of the durably-persisted first-response data: exact pinned revision reverified; three new targets preselected before generation; genuine first successful response retained for all 3 targets (0 crashes, 0 lost samples); real OpenAI used; all 12 proposals schema-safe; zero bounded-reference escapes; deterministic verifier authoritative throughout; zero false supports; at least one preselected TRUE target (R2-TDI-3, target B) proposed and SUPPORTED; all 12 supported claims independently checked correct; source navigation independently confirmed correct for all 3 targets; no credential leakage; no legacy/fake provider substitution.
